text:
IncidentBot: ALERT: realtime p99 spike detected for /v1/streaming/generate in us-west-2. 10m p99 = 3.8s (SLO 500ms). Auto-page to oncall.
Priya: Oncall Priya here, investigating.
Priya: @Mike @Jamie can you join the bridge? Need quick triage of error vs tail latency.
Mike: Joining. Pulling live dashboard -> https://dashboards.internal/redwood/streams?range=15m
Mike: Quick read: request rate +60% vs baseline, errors steady, tail (p99) shoots up. GPU utilization normal, but queueing on the serving pool increased.
Jamie: I'm seeing a KV prefix cache miss spike at ~04:02 UTC — miss_rate 8% -> 35% on stream-pool. Correlates with p99.
OpsBot: Autoscaler triggered for stream-pool-usw2 at 04:03 UTC (scaled +1 node).
Priya: Immediate mitigations to try now: 1) enable fallback prefix caching toggle, 2) shift low-priority routes to fallback model, 3) increase burst capacity while we root-cause.
Mike: Executing traffic shift command: `redwood router shift --route=/demo,/batch --from=stream-main --to=stream-fallback --pct=30 --region=us-west-2`
Mike: Also running quick KV eviction check: `kubectl -n redwood logs deploy/stream-pool | grep "kv_eviction" -A2` -> showing bursts of evictions around spike.
Priya: After shifting 30% traffic, p99 dropped to ~1.2s at 04:06 UTC. Still above SLO but trending down. :thumbsup:
Jamie: Noted three enterprise tenants (acct-337, acct-991, acct-204) with sustained >5s latencies. Flagging to CS to notify potential impact.
Lina: Adding collection checklist: dump kv cache metrics (prefix_hit/miss, eviction_rate), model rollout timeline (last 24h), serving pool queue depth per shard.
Priya: Can someone confirm if any model rollout/quantization changes in last 24h?
Mike: No model rollouts in last 24h on streaming-main; small-quant had a canary but only for batch route.
Priya: Good. Next steps: keep shift at 30% until p99 < 600ms or we restore cache hit ratio. If p99 plateaus, we'll increase to 50% and request additional capacity.
OpsBot: Burst capacity request submitted (req-8921), ETA ~6m.
Mike: I'll take the next 30-minute shift and own the postmortem. Priya, please handoff when you step out.
Priya: Handoff in 15m unless anything regresses. I've captured logs to ops/incident/1746667777 and created a slack channel #inc-1746667777-bridge for extended coordination.
IncidentBot: Incident created INC-1746667777 severity=P1, responders=[Priya,Mike,Jamie], link=https://incidents.internal/INC-1746667777
Lina: Note for postmortem: correlate KV cache TTL settings with recent traffic shape change, check kernel-level OOM logs on nodes with evictions.
Priya: Thanks all — staying on for 10 more minutes then handing to Mike. CS notified of impacted tenants.
Mike: If p99 remains <600ms for 10m, I'll mark mitigated and kick off RCA. Otherwise escalate to SRE and consider emergency prefix cache rollback.
Priya: Closing interim update: metrics trending down, customer impact contained to a handful of tenants. Will follow up in #inc-1746667777-bridge.
